xBRIEFInfo.description: Convert Lab 2 to the stateless helper shape so coding-agent hosts can run it
xBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-swarm

plan.title: Lab 2 runs from a coding-agent host without live shell state

narratives.Description: Lab 2 is the only lab whose command blocks carry shell functions and bare variables between blocks, so on Codex / Claude Code / Cursor every block after the first fails at assert_no_remote with 'command not found' — a failure that reads like the safety guard tripping. Convert it to the stateless helper shape Labs 5, 7, 10, 11 and the capstone already use.
narratives.Acceptance: Given a fresh shell per command block, when a learner runs Lab 2 from the first fence to archive, then every fence succeeds using only the course-relative helper path and one printed absolute attempt root, and node scripts/verify-modules-2-3.mjs and npm test both exit 0.
narratives.Traces: deftai/directive-training#18; accepted synthesis 'design-critique: synthesis accepted'; successor lean 5749920572; verified-claims table 5751273221
narratives.QualityGate: npm test, plus node scripts/verify-modules-2-3.mjs. Run deft check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint.
narratives.UserStory: As a self-directed learner on a coding-agent host, I want every Lab 2 command block to run in its own shell, so that the lab safety guard never appears to fail because of shell scoping.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add labs/fixtures/02-disposable-initialization/init-lab.mjs exposing create, install, guard, diagnose, accept and archive, each taking the absolute attempt root as its one argument and re-deriving its own state from disk. Govern helper-spawned children with env -i PATH and HOME, layer the withoutHostNpmConfig credential strip on top of that base, and keep Lab 2's --userconfig / --globalconfig / --cache flags (or Lab 7 runNpm's NPM_CONFIG_* overlays) on npm children. Prepend the printed root's node_modules/.bin for hook-runtime children and refuse before spawn when that local deft is absent or non-executable. Recut labs/02-disposable-initialization.md so each fence calls the helper with one printed root, guarded by fence-level test -n / test -f, and recut the recovery row, safety-boundary line and Task 4 fact table so a missing paste is not a boundary stop. Then re-run node scripts/verify-modules-2-3.mjs against the converted lab and recut the content contract and the modules-2-3 platform-validation workflow from what it reports, rather than from a closed lock list.

narrative.Acceptance: Given labs/fixtures/02-disposable-initialization/init-lab.mjs, when any of create, install, guard, diagnose, accept or archive is invoked with the absolute attempt root as its one argument, then it re-derives its own state from disk and succeeds in a shell that never ran the previous subcommand; and when it is invoked with an empty or relative root, then it refuses before resolve or join with text distinguishable from a boundary stop, and lab-state.json contains no caller PATH and no npm userconfig.

items.title: Govern helper-spawned children with env -i PATH and HOME

acceptance.derived_reason: derived 5 independently testable clauses from the task statement before product edit (#3323)

clauses.text: Helper exposes create / install / guard / diagnose / accept / archive subcommands, each taking the absolute attempt root as its one argument and re-deriving its own state. No caller PATH and no npm userconfig is stored in lab-state.json. In-helper refusal for an empty or relative root happens before resolve/join, with text distinguishable from a boundary stop. The recovery-drill npmrc parent is derived as dirname(printed root) inside the helper.

Governing env for helper-spawned children is env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" so nvm-class node stays reachable and host variables such as DEFT_HOOKS_PREFER_GLOBAL cannot cross. The withoutHostNpmConfig credential strip applies on top of that base, not in place of it. Helper npm children keep Lab 2's --userconfig / --globalconfig / --cache flags, or Lab 7 runNpm's matching NPM_CONFIG_* overlays applied to the env -i object. Lab 7 isolatedEnv, createIsolatedTools and git() are not reused.

Hook-runtime children prepend join(printedRoot, 'node_modules/.bin') to the env -i caller PATH. Before any hook-runtime child is spawned the helper refuses unless that local deft is present and executable, with text distinguishable from a boundary stop. A missing local .bin/deft never falls through to global deft.

Fence-level test -n / test -f guard the helper path, separate from the in-helper empty-root refusal, and both texts are distinguishable from a boundary stop. Recovery-table row 829, safety-boundary line 276 and Task 4 fact-table line 669 are recut so a missing printed-root paste is not 'Stop if the root guard fails'. Learner-visible O2.2 proof stays the explicit $lab_root/node_modules/.bin/directive and deft paths.

scripts/verify-modules-2-3.mjs is recut by re-running it against the converted lab, not by a closed lock list. The named restore / command -v deft / workflow recuts stay as the known minimum, including :286-298, :315, :325 and :608-611. The modules-2-3 platform-validation workflow and solutions/lab-02-disposable-initialization.md stay consistent with the converted lab, including the seven verbose git check-ignore commands the solution currently miscounts as six.
